## Overview

MarkdStage v4.1.0 improves PowerPoint export for Archify architecture imports and other
content with automatic sizing and metric scaling. The release also adds the Microsoft Store
listing assets and expands validation coverage for editable PowerPoint output, text wrapping,
and Windows package paths.

## Compatibility and migration

This release is backward compatible with v4.x. Update version-pinned installation references
to the v4.1.0 tag when adopting the new release.

| Area | Migration |
| --- | --- |
| Version-pinned installation | Update the pinned tag to `v4.1.0`. |
| Canvas Extension | Install `.github/extensions/markdstage` from the `v4.1.0` tag. |
| CLI | Update `@markdstage/markdstage` to version `4.1.0`. |
| Desktop | Use the v4.1.0 Windows package for the matching architecture. |
